_notes.pollenMassKg: UNMEASURED: the manual gives no mass
_notes.nectarMassKg: UNMEASURED: 0.020/0.015 = 1.33, which the team's two tip tests imply
_notes.hiveCellInnerMm: 9.42 in from the pivot to the near end of a Cell (18.84 in between the two Cells, Figure 9-9)
_notes.hiveCellBottomMm: chosen so the opening is 53.5 to 65.6 in above the floor when tilted 30 degrees (Figure 9-10)
_notes.hiveTipBalls: pollen-equivalents that tip a Cell: the team's test (3 nectar + 4 pollen, or 8 pollen). UNMEASURED
_notes.settleSeconds: balls settle into the Flowers and Cells this long before the match starts
_notes.shotMode: 0 = the ball leaves with the speed and angle the code's flywheel and hood give (Mode A); 1 = the sim solves a launch that lands in the nearest up Cell opening (Mode B)
_notes.shotSpeedPerRps: UNMEASURED: ball speed (m/s) per flywheel RPS. The default makes the code's own table value for launch point A (45.65 RPS) land in the up Cell
_notes.hoodMinAngleDeg: UNMEASURED: launch angle with the hood at its minimum. Chosen so the hood position the code's table gives for launch point A (about 0.167) is 62 degrees
_notes.hoodMaxAngleDeg: UNMEASURED: launch angle with the hood at its maximum position
_notes.exitHeightMm: UNMEASURED: where the ball leaves, above the floor (it must clear the robot top at 457 mm)
_notes.minFlywheelRps: UNMEASURED: below this the ball just drops out
_notes.shotIntervalMs: UNMEASURED: PushBall runs the intake 500 ms, so 4 balls leave about 110 ms apart
_notes.stopperOpenBelow: the stopper servo is open at 0.31 and closed at 0.47 (ModuleConfig); half way counts as open
_notes.intakeFrontReachMm: UNMEASURED: how far past the front tip the intake can pull a floor ball in
